title: Trapped In Antarctica. All 28 Men Survived 🧊
caption:
Twenty eight men were stranded in Antarctica. Every one survived 🧊
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1915 the ship Endurance was crushed by Antarctic ice. Ernest Shackleton led five men on an 800-mile open boat journey to South Georgia to get help, and by August 1916 every man of the expedition had been rescued.
Would you have followed him? 👇
first_comment: Not a single man was lost. Greatest leader in history? 🧊👇
